text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training for the day had ended, and just 
as I was about to head home with Yamanin 
Zephyr...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Not yet! Turbo's real run starts now! Here 
we go for another laaaaaap!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I can still run plenty more. I'll 
keep you company as long as my stamina 
lasts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like several Umamusume are 
diligently practicing on their own. 
Yamanin Zephyr watches them with fixed, 
intent eyes...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer. If it's all right with 
you, could we train just a little bit 
longer?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I was swept up in that fiery gale, you 
see...
choice_data_list: I was feeling the same way.
I was feeling the same way too.

Let's direct that enthusiasm into our next 
training session.

text_block_list.text:

see...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: So it was the same for you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It would be a waste to simply stand here 
and silently take this wind...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, I'll turn this into a 
tailwind and blow even stronger."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed, that is also true. Strong 
winds born from slowly developing 
atmospheric pressure—"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I will blow them all away 
during our next training session.
